posts.title: A bigger CPU number is always faster

slides.text: A bigger CPU number is always faster
THE TRUTH — Cores, clocks and cooling matter — a lower tier can beat a hotter, throttling higher one. The chassis that can't cool a chip is the real spec.
Share this with the person who still believes it.

The fastest way to find anything on a Mac
Spotlight is the app launcher and file finder

Spotlight is the app launcher and file finder

Drag onto the Dock to avoid desktop clutter
Use Activity Monitor to find the real battery hog
Screenshots live in one album — clean it weekly

posts.title: Set up 2FA on any account

slides.text:
Set up 2FA on any account
Open Settings > Security > Two-factor
Prefer an authenticator app over SMS
Scan the QR with your authenticator
Save the backup codes somewhere safe
Test a login with a code before you log out.
Save this — you'll need it next time.
